current_grouping: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: Ignition switches shall provide control for each ignition circuit on each engine. It shall be possible to shut off quickly all ignition on multiengine airplanes, either by grouping of the individual switches or by providing a master ignition control.
